name: Core HUD — Inventory
subtitle: OSRS UI composition reference vs Crafted Realms live browser HUD
review_note: The live inventory now uses a narrow carved frame, muted recessed field, free-floating item icons, compact top tabs, bottom utility tabs, and a warm low-contrast palette. The existing minimap remains unchanged.
improve: Complete icon-by-icon tab art as each corresponding gameplay panel reaches production scope.
